name: Yana
source:
Gracious and lofty, she is the great duchess who records all the history of Fluffland. Her residence is a huge library and she's the most knowledgeable fluff in all of Fluffland. Her nobility makes her seem aloof but if you listen closely you can hear the kindness in her words.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fluffness/fluffland]Kickstarter[/url]]
